summary: 15 of 15 requirements met in the delivered app and 73 of 73 effective value rows pass (82/82 sweep assertions, DOM rows re-verified in real Chromium), but NOT approved: the final whole-app audit found two blocking defects — an unexplained deletion of an assertion from the generated suite (the removed assertion passes against the delivered code) and recommender cards rendered as buttons but wired to nothing.
notes_for_next_agent: The delivered app is functionally complete: all 15 requirements are present and work end to end, all 73 effective V rows pass (value_sweep.ts: 82/82 assertions; V71–V73 re-verified in real Chromium), grading is 171 pass / 0 fail, and typecheck/oxlint/minified bundle/real-browser smoke (14/14 controls) are all clean. The two blockers are small and neither touches domain logic: (1) restore the one deleted suite line — verified to pass with no code change — and propose V74 for the R10 ordering invariant; (2) wire or de-button the recommender cards, and propose a DOM-observable V row for the chosen behaviour. To re-verify after repair: `bun test apps/app/app.test.ts apps/app/tests/generated/bcca0d92.test.ts` (171+ pass), `bun adws/adw_data/sessions/r1note/context_handoff/value_sweep.ts` (82/82), and `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/Users/ronaldwood/Library/Caches/ms-playwright uv run adws/adw_modules/render_smoke.py apps/app --eval <probe.js> --hash 'date=2025-06-18'` to confirm a recommendation card click now selects its slot. My review note in plan.md supersedes the earlier 'review_3 APPROVED' team note and records why.

findings.evidence: main.ts member-add (429-436), member-edit (510), member-edit-cancel (400), member-remove (519-522); every member-mutating path clears editingId (grep: 308/400/436/522, loadState default 86); V71/V73 pass in sweep AND real Chromium (form populated Zed/Asia/Kathmandu/09:00, 'Save changes', row count unchanged, shoulder→working; Ivy added after preset-interrupted edit)
presets.ts: the three exact spec names with fully configured members; Chromium probe: Global Core load → 3 rows; generated suite R2 tests pass

findings.requirement: R3 — accurate timezone conversion, DST, non-whole-hour offsets
findings.evidence: 19/19 conversion rows V1–V19 + DST boundary rows V57/V58 pass in sweep; offsets derived from Intl tzdata (timezone.ts:36-52), never hardcoded; no Intl display-name strings are user-visible (numeric offsets only)

findings.evidence: dayShift on every conversion; grid cells carry +1d/-1d badges and data-day-shift (main.ts:558-560); inspector shows local date with (+1d)/(−1d) (main.ts:586); V5/V6/V13–V19 pass
16/16 rows V28–V43 pass in sweep (half-open intervals, midnight-wrapping sleep)
DURATIONS=[15,30,45,60,90,120] (types.ts:29); 7/7 rows V60–V66 pass; suite R11/R6 test reclassifies Kathmandu 16:00Z shoulder→sleeping at 120m

findings.requirement: R7 — team scoring 0–100 with tiers, sleep strictly penalized
findings.evidence: 11/11 rows V44–V52+V68/V69 pass; any sleeper forces disruptive; exhaustive 81-combination generated test passes

findings.requirement: R8 — interactive 24-hour world clock matrix with selection highlight
findings.evidence: 24 hour-headers, status cells per member; V72 verified in real Chromium: exactly the hour-16 column selected (1 cell, class 'selected', header + score chip data-selected, 0 others); styles.css:219-230 has .selected rules

findings.requirement: R9 — active slot inspector with local times, dates, badges, offsets
findings.evidence: renderInspector (main.ts:567-605) per-member start–end, local date, offset, status badge; suite R8/R9 test (3 inspector rows incl. 04:00 Auckland) passes; Chromium: inspector populated after selection

findings.requirement: R10 — smart recommender: calculate and display ranked slots (zero-sleeping first, then score)
findings.evidence: Ordering verified independently over the exact suite inputs: 24 slots, 276 pairs, 0 violations; panel renders top 6 with counts and tier (Chromium: 6 items, first '00:00 UTC · optimal (100)')

findings.requirement: Approach/UI contract — recommender cards as one-click 'Select' buttons (a control must not exist wired to nothing)
findings.evidence: BLOCKING B2: renderRecommender (main.ts:619-636) creates <button data-testid="recommendation-item"> with no click listener; real-Chromium probe: clicking the first card leaves 0 selected cells (before and after) and the inspector still shows the 'Select a slot…' hint — the app's ranked output is a dead control

findings.requirement: R11 — meeting date, duration dropdown, 12/24h toggle, reference time base
findings.evidence: main.ts:164-254: type=date input, duration select over all six durations, format toggle wired to displayTime, reference-base wired to recommender label base; generated suite R11 tests pass
copy-invitation writes to clipboard and shows the 'Invitation copied' toast (main.ts:648-663); generated suite R12 test passes; smoke clicks it clean

findings.requirement: R13 — .ics download and Google Calendar link
findings.evidence: download-ics Blob download of generateIcsFile (valid RFC 5545, CRLF, one VEVENT — suite test); google-calendar-link carries the real dates=…%2F… href (V55 asserted on raw URL string); V53/V54/V59 pass

findings.requirement: R14 — team fairness insight: span, burden distribution, rotation guidance
findings.evidence: renderFairness (main.ts:667-702): span, per-member shoulder/sleeping burden, guidance text; V67 (1320 per A2) and V70 (540) pass; generated R14 tests pass

findings.requirement: R15 — state persistence across reloads via localStorage and URL hash
findings.evidence: save() writes localStorage and hash date=…&duration=… (main.ts:136-158); loadState() re-reads both (110-131); hash channel verified in real Chromium (dateFromHash '2025-06-18' on load); suite reload test re-imports a fresh module and passes

findings.requirement: Test-suite integrity — an assertion removed from a suite must be explained or trace to an accepted amendment
findings.evidence: BLOCKING B1: generated suite's R10 pairwise-ranking test lost `expect(violations).toEqual([]);` (removed vs the red commit); no amendment or note authorizes it (A2's scope was exactly the V67 literal/title/comment), and the assertion PASSES against the delivered code (probe: 24 slots, 276 pairs, 0 violations) — so the removal only weakens the suite; the test now computes violations and discards them, and R10's ordering has no V row to catch the gap

blocking: B1 — Restore the deleted assertion `expect(violations).toEqual([]);` at the end of the R10 pairwise-ranking test in apps/app/tests/generated/bcca0d92.test.ts (it was removed from the red suite with no amendment or note authorizing it, and my probe shows it PASSES against the delivered recommender — 24 slots, 276 pairs, 0 violations — so restoring it needs no code change). Also propose a V row (e.g. V74) pinning the recommender ordering invariant, which currently has no coverage in the answer key.

B2 — Wire the recommendation-item cards in renderRecommender (apps/app/main.ts:619-636) to select their slot (click must set state.selectedHour from the slot's start hour, then save and re-render), or render them as non-interactive text: they are currently <button> elements wired to nothing (real-Chromium probe: click → 0 selected cells, inspector unchanged), while the spec's Approach promises one-click 'Select' buttons and a delivered control must not be dead.
